title: GitHub commits table schema and migration
description: Define the github_commits table for storing commit records imported from GitHub. SHA must be unique per project to prevent duplicate imports.
acceptanceCriteria: FK to projects.id with cascade delete
sha field has UNIQUE constraint (global across all projects)
committed_at timestamp stores original commit time

steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/githubCommits.ts. Define github_commits table: id (uuid pk), project_id (uuid notNull FK → projects cascade delete), sha (varchar 40 notNull unique), message (text notNull), author_name (varchar 255 notNull), author_email (varchar 255 nullable), committed_at (timestamp notNull), url (text notNull), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()).
Add index on project_id and index on committed_at for timeline sorting.

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type GithubCommit and type NewGithubCommit. Add 'export * from ./githubCommits' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify unique constraint on sha.

technicalNotes: SHA uniqueness prevents re-importing the same commit during polling cycles
Use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (sha) DO NOTHING for idempotent imports
